newsitem.title: USA: WinStar, SNET sign interconnection deal.
newsitem.headline: WinStar, SNET sign interconnection deal.

text.p: Winstar Communications Inc said on Monday it has an interconnection agreement with Southern New England Telecommunications Corp covering the state of Connecticut.
WinStar, which currently provides long distance services in the Hartford and Stamford markets, said the agreement establishes the terms under which WinStar and SNET will interconnect their networks.
WinStar said it would provide local, long distance, and Internet access services to small- and medium-sized business customers in Connecticut.
